mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% in the accommodative monetary policy regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in the CPI inflation index above 250 (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating price pressures, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high inflation environment, S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 250.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a robust demand-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the expanding demand environment, 20d forward returns are not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise above their respective thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) and employment figures (PAYEMS) both above thresholds signal labor market recovery, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the labor market recovery phase, 5d forward returns are not positive when both UNRATE > 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals supply-side expansion, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, S&P 500 60d forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 110 in the supply-side expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in employment (PAYEMS below 140,000) indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the labor market contraction phase, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS drops below 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market strengthening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 5-day window, S&P 500 5d forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE is below 3.5% in the strengthening phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% in an accommodative monetary policy regime signals easing, lowering borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, S&P 500 60d forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% in the accommodative monetary policy regime.
